candidates.formal_type:
∀ (n : Nat) (adj : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Int),
  LE.le.{0} 1 n →
    Iff (Etingof.IsDynkinDiagram n adj)
      (Exists.{1} fun t =>
        Exists.{1} fun σ =>
          ∀ (i j : Fin t.rank), Eq.{1} (adj (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} σ i) (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} σ j)) (t.adj i j))

source_text: Every connected simply-laced positive-definite diagram is of type A, D, E6, E7, or E8, and conversely each listed type is Dynkin.
